#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    long long capacity, cost;
};

struct MinCostFlow {
    int n;
    std::vector<std::vector<Edge>> graph;
    std::vector<long long> dist;
    std::vector<int> prevv, preve;
    long long flow, cost;

    MinCostFlow(int n) : n(n), graph(n), dist(n), prevv(n), preve(n), flow(0), cost(0) {}

    void addEdge(int from, int to, long long cap, long long c) {
        graph[from].push_back({to, (int)graph[to].size(), cap, c});
        graph[to].push_back({from, (int)graph[from].size() - 1, 0, -c});
    }

    std::pair<long long, long long> minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
        long long totalFlow = 0, totalCost = 0;
        while (true) {
            std::fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), LLONG_MAX);
            dist[s] = 0;
            std::priority_queue<std::pair<long long, int>,
                                std::vector<std::pair<long long, int>>,
                                std::greater<>> pq;
            pq.push({0, s});
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto [d, v] = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                if (d > dist[v]) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[v].size(); ++i) {
                    auto &e = graph[v][i];
                    if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[v] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[v] + e.cost;
                        prevv[e.to] = v;
                        preve[e.to] = i;
                        pq.push({dist[e.to], e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == LLONG_MAX) break;
            long long d = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                d = std::min(d, graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]].capacity);
            }
            totalFlow += d;
            totalCost += d * dist[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                auto &e = graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.capacity -= d;
                graph[v][e.rev].capacity += d;
            }
        }
        return {totalFlow, totalCost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n; cin >> n;
    string s; cin >> s;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }

    int size = n + 100;
    int source = n + 98;
    int target = source + 1;
    MinCostFlow g(size);

    for (int i = 0; i * 2 < n; ++i) {
        g.addEdge(i, target, 2, 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        g.addEdge(source, i + n, cnt[i], 0);
        for (int j = 0; j * 2 < n; ++j) {
            int w = 0;
            if (s[j] == s[n - j - 1]) {
                if (s[j] - 'a' == i) w = -std::max(a[j], a[n - j - 1]);
                g.addEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
            } else {
                if (s[j] - 'a' == i) w -= a[j];
                if (s[n - j - 1] - 'a' == i) w -= a[n - j - 1];
                g.addEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
            }
        }
    }

    auto [flow, minCost] = g.minCostMaxFlow(source, target);
    cout << -minCost << "\n";

    return 0;
}
